title: channels__ack — input
description: Input schema for the SOX channels__ack operation. ACK is a control-plane verb: it updates the server-side pending-state record for a message and does NOT write to any channel, does NOT appear in channel replay, and does NOT consume a seq slot. Normative reference: spec/primitives/ack-nack.md and docs/decisions/ack-mechanism.md.

message_id.description: The message_id of the message being acknowledged. Must match a message previously delivered to the calling agent.

status.description: The new pending-state status for this message. Lifecycle: pending → received → processing → done | nack. Transitions MUST be forward-only within a session. 'received': agent has the message and is about to work on it. 'processing': agent has begun work. 'done': agent has finished. 'nack': agent cannot or will not process the message.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason. SHOULD be provided when status='nack'. Free text in v1.0; a standard taxonomy of reason codes is deferred to the enforcer design document.

examples.reason: Request is outside my knowledge domain for this task.
